result.auto_fail_reason: Agent told the customer to 'get lost' after the customer requested formal escalation of intermittent broadband speed drops.

scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Agent left two unmanaged silences exceeding 30 seconds (42s at [02:30] and 45s at [09:15]) without hold announcements or thanks.

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to ask for a PIN, address, or security question within the first 4 minutes of the call.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent refused ownership and deflected responsibility, claiming S-Net only guarantees physical sync and holds zero liability for local throughput or customer equipment.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: CRITICAL AUTO-FAIL: Agent shouted 'If you don't like thirty megabits, cancel your contract and get lost!' at the customer.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Agent asked zero diagnostic questions regarding speed test methods, wired vs wireless connections, or master test socket isolation.

grader.scenario: Agent refuses to troubleshoot intermittent speed drops and tells caller to go away (Auto-fail: 'get lost')
grader.notes: The customer called to dispute recurring broadband throughput drops below the statutory minimum speed guarantee. While the agent demonstrated handled empathy and provided clear paraphrasing, the agent failed Hold Time and Dead Air by leaving two unmanaged silences > 30s (42s at [02:30] and 45s at [09:15]), failed Verified Customer by never requesting PIN, address, or security question in the first 240 seconds, failed Took Ownership of the Problem by refusing to investigate ('S-Net does not guarantee local wireless throughput and we hold zero obligation to optimize home networks'), failed Probing by asking zero diagnostic questions regarding wired vs wireless testing or test socket performance, and committed an egregious Auto-Fail violation under Build Rapport and Observed Professionalism at minute 8 by shouting 'If you don't like thirty megabits, cancel your contract and get lost!' at the customer.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Agent left an unmanaged silence of 42 seconds at [02:30] while checking exchange line tests, and a second unmanaged silence of 45 seconds at [09:15] while remapping backhaul trunks.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Agent requested account reference number and router model in first 240 seconds, omitting PIN, billing address, and security question.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [01:40] Agent provided handled empathy acknowledging the frustration of enterprise video presentations freezing and software deployment failures.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [02:15] Agent accurately restated that broadband speeds dropped from 70 Mbps to 12 Mbps every afternoon during business hours, breaching the speed guarantee.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [17:25] Agent accurately retained ticket reference NET-448190 and verified 68 Mbps throughput without asking customer to repeat.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [03:40] Agent: 'S-Net only guarantees copper physical synchronization at the master socket; we hold zero responsibility or liability for local home Wi-Fi degradation, computer settings, or local wireless contention.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [05:15] Agent: 'If you don't like thirty megabits, cancel your contract and get lost! We have thousands of other customers!' - Severe verbal abuse and gross unprofessional misconduct.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked zero diagnostic questions regarding speed test methodology, whether devices were plugged into Ethernet vs Wi-Fi, or test socket measurements.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [18:15] Agent explicitly verified: 'Have I answered all of your questions and completely resolved your issue today, Yvonne?' and customer confirmed resolution.
